stem: Which statement correctly distinguishes xylem from phloem?
choices: Xylem conducts water and dissolved mineral nutrients; phloem distributes sugars and other organic compounds among source and sink tissues
Xylem produces pollen; phloem receives pollen
Xylem is the space between nodes; phloem is a shoot meristem
Xylem controls stomatal pores; phloem forms glandular trichomes
rationale: Xylem and phloem are vascular tissues with different transport roles. Correct structural identification helps learners reason about water, nutrient, and carbon movement without treating all transport as one process.
